review: 702.18a-1: the own_shroud_creature variant changed the spell, the land and the target at once; it now changes only the target (A's own Humble Budoka for the same Lightning Bolt), and Giant Growth and Forest are dropped.

scenarios.title: A permanent with shroud cannot be the target of any spell or ability, even its controller's
decisions: A attempts to cast Lightning Bolt targeting B's Humble Budoka, tapping Mountain.

variants.label: opposing_shroud_creature
variants.expected: B's Humble Budoka (shroud) is not a legal target for Lightning Bolt; the cast is illegal.

variants.label: no_shroud_creature
variants.delta: A attempts to target B's Grizzly Bears instead of Humble Budoka.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is a legal target for Lightning Bolt; the cast is legal.

operation.unclassifiable: target: A targets B's Grizzly Bears instead of Humble Budoka.

variants.label: own_shroud_creature
variants.delta: A attempts to target A's own Humble Budoka instead of B's.
variants.expected: A's Humble Budoka (shroud) is not a legal target for A's Lightning Bolt; the cast is illegal.

operation.unclassifiable: target: A targets its own Humble Budoka instead of B's.

detector.outcome: A spell or ability's candidate lists its legal targets, and an entity or player that the rule keeps out (hexproof, shroud, protection, an enchant or equip restriction) is outside that list.
detector.near_miss: An entity or player that the same kind of restriction allows is listed in the candidate's legal targets.
